custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a new customer (created for this test), customer A, with an invoice of $100.00 paid $120.00 (overpaid), and an open invoice B of $500.00 on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with the Customer filter showing only customer A ticked.

Setup

  1. Make customer A: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type a new Name for customer A, type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, fill Make and the other boxes the window marks as required, then click Save.
  2. Make invoice 1: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, then click Save (click Ok if a Customer Notes window opens). In the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 100.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete; in Tech stories type a story and click Complete All Lines (if Missing Details asks for Mileage, type it and click Complete All Lines again). Open the Finance tab and click Mark Reviewed (if a window asks for the VIN, type one and click Confirm Review). Type today's date in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment window opens, type 120.00 in the Payment box on this invoice's row, pick a Payment Method, then click Make Payment.
  3. Make invoice B: Same way as invoice 1, on customer A's page: Fixed Line Total 500.00; type today's date in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
custom_steps:
1. Read customer A's row.
  2. Read the Totals row and compare it with the row above it, column by column.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The row counts only invoice B: Total $500.00.
  • The overpaid invoice is not in the row.

Step 2:

  • The Totals row's Total reads $500.00.
  • Every column of the Totals row equals customer A's row: the Totals row adds up exactly the rows above it.

To set this up, record a payment of $120.00 on the $100.00 invoice.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • What changes for existing users: “The A/R Summary Totals row now adds up exactly the customer rows above it. Today it also counts overpaid invoices (an invoice paid for more than its amount), which the rows don't, so for those customers the Totals don't match the rows. Production has 16 such invoices across 13 customer accounts; their A/R Summary Totals will differ slightly from today. The rows themselves don't change.”
  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”

Partly checked against build v26.45.2-6a8b89c (QA site sv11315) on 11/10/2026; not yet seen on that build: paying more than an invoice's balance.

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

The design's own words:

  • "Customer picked: the group row shows "Phone:" and, for users with View and Manage AP/AR Data, "Credit term:". The Totals row follows the customer filter. S9-R1, S9-R2, S5-R18. Exports carry the same lines and columns: S9-R3, S3-R5, S3-R8a." (caption of "Call list on A/R Collection")
